units.source_text: 船上三人一起抓住倒下的桅杆，在汹涌的波涛中漂浮着。

en.t: The three people on board clung together to the fallen mast, drifting amid the surging waves.

units.source_text: 这时候，机动船前往援救去了。

en.t: At that moment, the motorboat went out to rescue them.

units.source_text: 他们安然无恙，只喝了几口海水。

en.t: They were safe and sound, having swallowed only a few mouthfuls of seawater.

units.source_text: 要是我那年幼的弟弟也混在其中，男的就他一个人。

en.t: If my young brother had been among them too, he would have been the only male there.

units.source_text: 女学生不怎么会游泳，不知会变成什么样子。

en.t: The schoolgirl could hardly swim, and there is no telling what might have happened.
